title: A cargo puzzle built with AI: can you spot the placement that jams the next load?
author: Tartalitus
selftext:
Last Dock is a small browser puzzle made with AI coding assistance. Pick a crate from the current shipment, then choose a column. It drops straight down; full horizontal rows clear. The next shipment is visible, so keeping an entry path matters as much as finding empty space.



The first idea was too close to a generic block-placement game. The current test adds top-entry loading and a choice of cargo order. A separate AI reviewer checked the rules, and a solver found a way through all eight shipments. That tells us it works, but it does not tell us whether people enjoy it.



Free playable sample: [https://lastdock.abastio.com/](https://lastdock.abastio.com/) . Desktop browser; no signup, purchases or ads.



If you try it, was the goal clear within about a minute, where did the rules first become unclear, and did you choose to restart after your first attempt? We are testing this small loop before adding more content. AI-assisted development and review are not substitutes for that feedback.
